title: On the big screen
summary: The club offers to put a message from you on the big screen at half time, for your partner, who's in the stand. The lads assume you're proposing. A season on, the big screen asks again.

ends.title: The screen
ends.text: You put a message for your partner on the big screen. Twenty thousand people read it before she did.

ends.title: Just a text
ends.text: You sent your partner a text at half time instead of the big screen. She liked that better.

beats.title: Half time

event.title: Half time
event.speaker: partner
setup: The club's media lad has an idea for Saturday: a message from you on the big screen at half time, for {partner.short}, who'll be in the family stand. The lads in the canteen have already decided you're proposing.

say: The media lad has a form. "Twenty words, max. Anything you like. No proposing unless you tell me first, because we need the camera on her."

screen.text: Half time. It goes up. The camera finds her, and she covers her face with a scarf. The family stand claps. Your phone has forty messages asking if you've proposed.

joke.text: Half time: RING YOUR MUM in big letters. She laughs so hard she's on the camera for longer than the replay. She rings your mum.

text.text: You text her at half time. She sends back a photo of her pie, and the canteen is disappointed.

beats.hint: The club offers you the big screen

beats.title: The lads

event.title: The lads
event.speaker: partner
setup: The lads have printed the big screen message and stuck it on your peg. Someone has drawn a ring on it.

say: {partner.short} comes to pick you up and sees it through the door.

replies.label: Take it down before she sees it properly.
Tear it up in front of the lads.

laugh.text: She laughs too. On the way home she asks, very lightly, if you've ever thought about it.

bin.text: The lads go quiet. She sees that too.

beats.hint: The lads won't stop about the big screen

beats.title: Again

event.title: Again
event.speaker: partner
setup: A season on. The media lad is back with his form.
{if arc.path=='screen'}"Same again? It was the most watched clip of the season. Or are you finally going to do it properly?"{/if}
{if arc.path=='text'}"Last chance. She'd love it. Everyone says she'd love it."{/if}
{if arc.deep=='laugh'}She hasn't forgotten the drawing of the ring on your peg.{/if}

outcomes.text: You write something only she'll understand. Twenty thousand people read it and don't get it, and she does.
You text her at half time. She texts back from the stand, three rows from the front, and you can see her laughing on the screen anyway.

beats.hint: A season on, the big screen
